design: All60 ranked H862 unions, all5 architectures, bothseeds, both discoveryaxes,8/32/64 budgets. Frozen taskaxis projected into union and normalized; no downstream fit.
interventions: Full union projection, within-union rank1 projection, orthogonal union complement, and rank1 rescaled to full union edit norm. Norm-matched rank1 is pairwise oracle, not a single-input encoding. All rawstate difference transfers preserve recipient remainder.
metrics: Both tasks, all156 recipients. Reference full rawrelay effect plus rerun fullunion effect, rank1/complement interaction residual and KL(union||rank1). Reused research tasks; supervised selection, not manifold discovery. No reservedtest.
